conditions: A realization boundary is lawfully open for migration, refactor or bounded implementation work.
exceptions: Cross-boundary follow-up can proceed separately only if admitted by its owning authority at the smallest lawful re-entry point.

grounding.quote:
When a realization boundary is lawfully open for migration, refactor, or
bounded implementation work, the area should be left better than it was found.

This does not outrank constitutional truth, declared module ownership evidence,
or functional equivalence. It is subordinate to them.

Opportunistic optimization is lawful only when it is:

- boundary-local to the active design or module surface
- behavior-preserving at the declared semantic boundary
- authority-neutral, with no change to ownership of truth
- visibility-neutral, with no silent promotion of subordinate payloads
- effect-neutral, with no hidden expansion of runtime, persistence, or
  bootstrap doctrine

When a cross-boundary opportunity is discovered during lawful cleanup, it must
not be silently absorbed into the active boundary. It is repricing input. If
the owning authority admits follow-up implementation, that work enters
separately at the smallest lawful re-entry point.

This method owns the scope-separation rule. It does not own the work-tracking
mechanism. For ticketed work, `TICKET_METHOD.md` governs whether admitted
follow-up is recorded and how it affects ticket closure.

constraints.statement: Leaving the area better is recommended and subordinate to constitutional truth, ownership evidence and functional equivalence. Lawful optimization requires all of boundary locality, semantic behavior preservation, authority neutrality, visibility neutrality and effect neutrality. Examples include removing parser re-entry on locally assembled truth, consolidating local routes, improving local algorithms/scans with unchanged semantics, and simplifying fixtures/module tests without changing claims. Cross-module lookup/index/cache/persistence repricing; public carrier/visibility/truth-ownership changes; wider effects/observability doctrine; and performance changing Product expectations require explicit design re-entry. Cross-boundary discoveries are repricing inputs, not silently absorbed work. Ticket Method owns recording and ticket-closure effects; cleanup cannot cover unauthorized redesign.
constraints.uncertainty: The Ticket Method's tracking and closure rules are outside the supplied source.

conditions: The same realization pattern occurs across more than one processed boundary; the second credible recurrence triggers review.
exceptions: A third local rebuild is conformant only if it consumes an existing reusable surface, extends it before local implementation lands, or has an explicit reviewed do-not-commonize decision explaining boundary specificity.

grounding.quote:
The rule of two is:

- the second credible recurrence forces a library/commonization review
- the third local rebuild is not acceptable by default

A third local rebuild is not design-method conformant unless one of these is
true:

- the active boundary consumes an existing reusable library/commonization surface
- the active boundary extends that surface before the local implementation lands
- review records an explicit do-not-commonize decision and why the pattern is
  still boundary-specific

For ticketed implementation work, `TICKET_METHOD.md` owns the ticket-level
recording and enforcement of that decision through fields such as
`library_usage`, `governing_library`, and `library_rationale`. This section
defines the design-method review obligation, not a rival ticket lifecycle.

If commonization would change ownership, public carriers, module boundaries, or
shared/common law, it is no longer recurrence extraction. It is a separate
design decision and must be treated that way.

Commonization closes only when the selected path consumes the accepted relation
and superseded production responsibility is retired or satisfies
`SPEC_METHOD.md`'s retention relation. Compare removed work and maintained
responsibilities across the path; shared names, fewer lines or an unused common
helper do not establish contraction.

constraints.statement: Treat repeated cross-boundary patterns as commonization candidates, not merely local cleanup. Second credible recurrence requires library review; third rebuild is not accepted by default and requires a listed exception. Ticket Method owns recording/enforcement, including library_usage/governing_library/library_rationale. Prefer local cleanup, then tenant-local library, then shared propagation only through separate design re-entry. Tenant-local authority-neutral reusable patterns should be extracted instead of recreated. Changes to ownership, public carriers, module boundaries or shared law are separate design decisions. Closure requires the selected path to consume the accepted relation and superseded production responsibility to be retired or lawfully retained; compare removed work and maintained responsibilities. Shared names, reduced line count and unused helpers do not prove contraction.
constraints.uncertainty: The external retention relation and ticket enforcement mechanics are not supplied.

conditions: A ticket adopts the method and claims its boundary processed or closed.
exceptions: The bounded check can be normal verification without a separate artifact, round or reviewer.
Current accepted evidence can be reused after exact scope, trace, applicability and invalidator checks; a new role/conversation/review alone does not require reauthoring.
Optional opportunities do not automatically widen scope, block a bounded claim or require follow-up tickets.

grounding.quote:
That check must determine:

- whether the boundary stayed lawful under the current design and module assets
- whether the exact claim includes every causally applicable live requirement,
  accepted design relation, and retained predecessor claim
- whether the exact closure claim leaves competing or ambiguous authority on
  its acceptance path
- whether implementation established a material architectural decision with
  durable consequences that forecloses an admitted Product outcome
- whether any discovered issue falsifies the current claim or an applicable
  hard stop

The check reconstructs the complete selected function from governing
requirements through the accepted Ontology, Prime atoms, IACS, views, target
modules, implementation, and module-owned proof. It does not begin and end with
previous review findings. Exact hashes establish subject identity; headings
and artifact presence establish location; green tests establish only the
properties they actually assert. None supplies a missing semantic relation or
substitutes a weaker property for the governed claim.

The required consequence is:

- an issue that falsifies the current claim or applicable hard stop blocks the
  design-method closure claim
- ticket or review wording cannot narrow applicable active authority away
- boundary-local cleanup or commonization is absorbed only when required to make
  the current claim true, preserve singular authority, satisfy accepted design,
  or avoid the durable architectural foreclosure above
- other cleanup, recurrence, generality, and cross-boundary opportunities are
  repricing inputs; they do not automatically widen the subject, block its
  bounded claim, or require a follow-up ticket
- any repricing admitted by the owning authority enters through the smallest
  lawful re-entry point

This rule keeps design closure truthful without turning discovery into automatic
scope expansion. Current defects and hard stops remain blocking. Useful
observations may survive as repricing input. Unclaimed future capability and
optional cleanup do not become implicit work.

No processed ticket that has adopted this method should claim design-method
closure until this bounded design check is complete.

constraints.statement: Before method closure, check processed boundary against accepted basis and exact claim; implementation status alone should not support closure. Determine lawfulness, coverage of every causally applicable live requirement/accepted relation/retained predecessor claim, ambiguous/competing acceptance authority, durable architectural foreclosure of admitted Product outcomes, and falsifying issues/hard stops. Reconstruct the selected function through requirements, Ontology, Prime atoms, IACS, views, modules, code and module proof, not just prior findings. Hashes identify subjects, headings/artifacts locate them, and green tests prove only asserted properties; none replaces semantics. Selected function means causal closure of the claim, not whole Product/history. Missing/stale/ambiguous coverage is not no-delta proof. Material changes/counterexamples require affected reconstruction/gates while conserving supported unaffected relations and full required changed-boundary coverage. Falsifying issues/hard stops block; wording cannot remove active authority. Absorb local cleanup/commonization only if needed for claim truth, singular authority, accepted design or avoiding foreclosure. Other observations are repricing input; admitted repricing uses smallest lawful re-entry. Ticket Method retains status/closure/reopening/dependency/follow-up ownership.

conditions: For a crossing between interface families.
exceptions: When the consumer is a view, Faithful projection also applies.

grounding.quote:
For a crossing between interface families, apply
[Contract application](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#contract-application) to their
declared source and consumer roles; apply Faithful projection when the consumer
is a view. Each family has its authoritative source, and downstream interfaces
consume it. Projection-to-closure, report/prompt-to-admission,
wrapper-to-kernel and adapter-to-semantic-owner changes are undeclared authority
transfers, not ordinary interface translation. This is semantic non-bleed;
smaller functions alone do not establish it.

constraints.statement: Bind declared source/consumer roles under Contract application, and Faithful projection for views. Each interface family retains its authoritative source consumed downstream. Projection-to-closure, report/prompt-to-admission, wrapper-to-kernel and adapter-to-semantic-owner changes are undeclared authority transfers, not ordinary translations. Smaller functions alone do not establish non-bleed.

conditions: For projects using this method and retained proxy/partial interfaces.
exceptions: Intentional compatibility must be an explicit feature with its own bounded authority and proof.

grounding.quote:
Projects using this method must not use proxy or partial interface
implementation as a substitute for real migration or real design completion.

A proxy interface is a new-looking surface that:

- forwards to the old authority path
- reconstructs missing truth from the old path
- keeps the old path executable behind a new name
- allows proofs to stay green while the old law still governs

This is bridge debt, not progress.

If compatibility is intentionally retained, it must be treated as an explicit
feature with its own bounded authority and proof.

Otherwise the proxy path must be removed.

constraints.statement: Proxy/partial interfaces cannot substitute for real migration or design completion. New-looking surfaces forwarding old authority, reconstructing truth from old paths, preserving old executable paths under new names, or keeping proofs green while old law governs constitute bridge debt. Remove the proxy path unless compatibility is explicitly retained as a bounded, proven feature.

conditions: For exact adopted boundary and claim.
exceptions: Python Typing applies for Python; ODD/UX owners apply to corresponding specialization.

grounding.quote:
A review result identifies the concrete predicates, their evidence and residuals
through the shared result contract. A missing answer on a required relation
prevents the corresponding design-conformance claim; use the owner to determine
whether the defect is coupling, imperative meaning, incompleteness or another
failed relation.

| Algorithms and dependencies | [Capability And Foundation Selection](#capability-and-foundation-selection-stdo-up-023) and [Computational Realization Projection](#computational-realization-projection-stdo-up-019). Inspect discovery, material exclusions/unknowns, candidate compositions, eliminative failures, the undominated frontier, role conservation and recursive material subproblems. |
| Cleanup, reuse and scope | [Opportunistic Optimization](#11b-opportunistic-optimization-rule), [Recurrence Extraction](#11c-recurrence-extraction-rule) and [Post-Ticket Design Review](#11d-post-ticket-design-review-rule). Inspect the exact claim, hard stops, prior recurrence and any separately admitted re-entry. |
| Runtime or UX specialization | [ODD Alignment And Escalation](#3a-odd-alignment-and-escalation-rule) and the applicable ODD/UX owner. Inspect whether a module realizes the published traversal or has acquired its control authority. |
| Intended operational use | [Module Lifecycle Confirmation](#6c-module-lifecycle-confirmation-rule) and its Spec lifecycle owner. Inspect phase evidence, reasoned exclusions and owned gaps. |

constraints.statement: Acquire owners with actual design/code. Review meaning/effects/mutation/ingress/defaults through Core Rule, Functional Bias, Authority Seam Closure, Ingress Collapse, Immutable Carrier, Totality, Effect-Edge, No Semantic Center, Coupling, Interface Bleed, Proxy and Governance/Strategy owners, inspecting source-consumer/effect paths. Typed closure uses Enforcement After Proof and Python Typing where applicable, checking ingress and strict-checker boundary. Atom/carrier justification uses Ontology-First, Atomic Functions, Prime, IACS, Promotion and Inflation over complete families/domains/mappings. Domain/behavior/lifecycle/authority uses the gate/cross-view owners over networks, views, messages, authority, constructors and proportionality. Reference/module proof uses reference derivation, evidence route and Unit Test owners. Algorithms use UP-023/computational projection over discovery, exclusions/unknowns, compositions, eliminative failures, undominated frontier, roles and recursive subproblems. Cleanup/reuse uses optimization/recurrence/post-ticket owners over exact claims, hard stops, recurrence/re-entry. Runtime/UX checks lawful traversal versus acquired control authority through ODD/UX owners. Lifecycle checks phase evidence/exclusions/gaps through its Spec owner. Results identify concrete predicates/evidence/residuals; missing required answers prevent corresponding conformance claims, with defect classification left to the owning rule.
constraints.uncertainty: Several routed owners occur outside the supplied sections.

conditions: A claim of functional bias, pure transforms, immutable carriers, single-owner truth or low coupling, in any language for modules, carriers or data entities.
exceptions: Apply owning gates' proportional sequencing and conditional exceptions; the checklist adds no stricter duplicate gate.
An unchanged boundary reuses accepted basis/no-material-delta evidence without new Ontology, IACS, views, axiom evaluation or unit-test lane merely because review occurs.

grounding.quote:
For a new or materially changed boundary, the owning gates require accepted
Ontology and design, complete lifecycle/authority/function evidence,
whole-family Prime and domains, applicable foundation selection, complete
three-view axiom evaluation, and the module/lifecycle proof required by those
owners. Apply their proportional sequencing and conditional exceptions;
this checklist does not introduce stricter duplicate gates.

Two proof duties of this functional-realization claim remain explicit:
functional equivalence to the specification and, when present, the reference
realization at the semantic boundary; and negative proof that imperative,
open-payload or effect-edge-erasure bypasses fail closed. An ODD-governed
boundary additionally uses ODD's supported real authority-path proof.

For an unchanged boundary, use the accepted basis and no-material-semantic-delta
evidence under the gate's reuse rule. No new Ontology, IACS, three-view asset,
axiom evaluation or unit-test lane follows merely from this review occurrence.
A required current defect blocks the corresponding claim; optional discovery
uses Post-Ticket Design Review's scope rule.

constraints.statement: Select section 4 policies and section 14 owner routes for the exact boundary, evaluating admitted Ontology, atom/IACS mapping, three views, computational binding, implementation and module proof. New/material changes require accepted Ontology/design, lifecycle/authority/function evidence, whole-family Prime/domains, applicable foundation selection, complete cross-view evaluation and owned module/lifecycle proof. Explicit duties are semantic-boundary functional equivalence to specification and any reference realization, plus negative proof that imperative, open-payload and effect-edge-erasure bypasses fail closed. ODD-governed boundaries additionally require supported real authority-path proof. Current required defects block corresponding claims; optional discoveries follow bounded scope rules.
constraints.uncertainty: Section 4, foundation selection and ODD proof contracts are only referenced here.

conditions: When a project adopts the method for a named boundary.
exceptions: Partial adoption may narrow scope, with explicit naming of boundary/rule family recommended, but cannot bypass needed completion evidence.

grounding.quote:
Every new or materially changed adopted semantic boundary must declare or cite
its accepted Ontology before claiming design-method completion. The Ontology
evidence must include entity lifecycle, authority, function derivation,
whole-family Prime, each accepted atom's admitted domain, atom-to-realization
projection mappings, and projection traceability at the granularity applicable
to the material change.

When the material change includes schema or typed carrier work, the project
must derive and reconcile the Irreducible Architectural Carrier Set from that
Ontology before claiming design-method completion.

When the new or materially changed boundary is derived from an existing
realization, the project must also publish the reference-to-target derivation
asset and the Ontology-derived three-view design asset before claiming
design-method completion for the changed boundary.

When the new or materially changed boundary has active implementation, the
project must also publish a module-derived unit test lane before claiming
closure for that change.

Partial adoption is allowed, but the adopted boundary and adopted rule family
should be named explicitly.

Partial adoption may narrow scope.

It must not be used to claim design-method completion while skipping the evidence
needed to audit, refactor, or reconstruct the realized boundary.

constraints.statement: Adoption must be consistent across the named boundary's Ontology/architecture derivation, modules, runtime/kernels, prompt/report paths, constructors/materializers and projection/query surfaces. Carrier/schema/governance migrations should explicitly name Boundary Closure Evaluators in ADR/ticket. New/materially changed semantic boundaries must declare/cite accepted Ontology before completion, including lifecycle, authority, function derivation, whole-family Prime, every accepted atom's domain, realization mappings and applicable-granularity traceability. Material schema/typed-carrier changes require Ontology-derived reconciled IACS; reference-derived changes also publish derivation and three-view assets; active implementation additionally publishes a module-derived test lane before change closure. Partial adoption cannot skip evidence needed for audit, refactor or reconstruction.
constraints.uncertainty: Boundary Closure Evaluators are named but not defined in this supplied span.

conditions: According to the applicable method surface; ODD and UX provisions apply only in their stated domains.
exceptions: UX Method is loaded only when work realizes a UX surface; lifecycle confirmation does not decide release eligibility or rollout.

grounding.quote:
- `SPEC_METHOD.md` governs constitutional process, authority flow, repricing,
  and migration law
- `RELEASE_METHOD.md` governs release-cut, Product, install, qualification, and
  version-line promotion evaluation
- `ODD_METHOD.md` governs graph-native constructive carrier law
- `DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` governs preferred realization structure inside
  implementation and design modules
- `UX_METHOD.md` refines this method for UX surfaces with rendering,
  state-transition, and effect-membrane rules; load it only when the work
  realizes a UX surface

For ODD-governed products, `ODD_METHOD.md` decides whether the operative unit is
an outcome traversal, graph function, GTL module, or ABG runtime boundary.
`DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` then governs the deterministic module structure that
realizes, evaluates, adapts, or projects inside that ODD boundary. When that
boundary includes a UX surface, `UX_METHOD.md` adds the render-purity,
reducer-purity, effect-membrane, and AssetSurface-binding rules required for
strong functional consistency between front-end and back-end.

The module lifecycle confirmation rule in this method detects whether the
realization has enough lifecycle signal to be safely built and reviewed. It
does not decide release eligibility, exact-cut acceptance, selector promotion,
install policy, or operational rollout. Those decisions remain governed by
`RELEASE_METHOD.md` and project-owned release, deployment, or operational
surfaces.

constraints.statement: Spec owns constitutional process, authority flow, repricing and migration. Release owns lawful release/Product/install, qualification, exact-cut acceptance, selector and version-line promotion. ODD owns graph-native carrier/product law and chooses outcome traversal, graph function, GTL module or ABG runtime boundary for ODD products. Design Module governs deterministic structure realizing/evaluating/adapting/projecting inside that boundary. UX adds render/reducer purity, state transitions, effect membrane and AssetSurface binding for UI/UX realization. Lifecycle confirmation supplies build/review signal; release eligibility, exact-cut acceptance, selector promotion, installation and rollout remain with Release and project operational owners.
constraints.uncertainty: These external methods' substantive laws are not supplied.

conditions: Composition/effect-algebra duty applies where a boundary composes higher-order functions or effectful computation.
exceptions: No specific programming language, elimination of all imperative code, monadic/category-theory vocabulary, or conversion of every exception to custom algebraic type is required.

grounding.quote:
This method does not require:

- one specific programming language
- elimination of all imperative code
- monadic or category-theory vocabulary
- replacing every exception with a custom algebraic type

It does require that the implementation shape remain readable, modular, and
honest about where meaning lives and where effects happen.

Where a boundary composes higher-order functions or effectful computation, it
does require an explicit composition and effect algebra with its applicable
identity, closure, cardinality, effect, and authority-conservation laws. The
vocabulary is optional; the law is not.

constraints.statement: Implementation must remain readable, modular and explicit about meaning/effects. Higher-order/effectful composition requires explicit composition/effect algebra with applicable identity, closure, cardinality, effect and authority-conservation laws. Terminology is optional; the applicable law is required.

conditions: Within the selected purposeful-construction methodology domain.
exceptions: Specialization does not assign unrelated software/calculus definitions a shared purpose, signature or workflow.

grounding.quote:
STDO specifies purposeful construction by actors with finite resources. This
member declares the foundational commitments for that method domain and the
premises on which its conditional construction contracts depend. The
[Transformation Library](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md) defines their shared
contract operations; particular methods bind their types, predicates, refinements
of the result algebra and authority. Neither adopted premises nor an entailment argument
appoints an actor or supplies an operation grant.

The core owns the shared decisions about results, current state, bounded work,
authority conservation, required independent assessment and construction assurance. Particular methods supply domain predicates, types,
policies and authority bindings. They apply those decisions without maintaining
parallel rules. A specialization does not assign unrelated software or calculus
definitions a common purpose, signature or workflow.

constraints.statement: Foundations declares commitments/premises; Transformation Library owns shared operations; particular methods bind domain types, predicates, result refinements, policies and authority. Core owns results, current state, bounded work, authority conservation, required independence and construction assurance, which methods apply without parallel deciding rules. Adopted premises and entailment arguments appoint no actor and supply no operation grant.

grounding.quote:
An actor has finite attention, context, time, storage and capability. This is a
resource premise. It does not choose an outcome, confer authority, identify an
object or prove compatible composition. Those commitments require their own
premises.

A selected purpose U_foundation supplies an adequacy predicate and reserved value choices.
An object O_subject supplies a scoped identity, boundary, current state and material
relations. An interpretation context kappa_interpretation determines the meaning available to
a consumer. A governing specification Sigma_contract declares obligations and admissible
variation. For an evaluation performing operations, the imported operation authority bounds
its permitted effects. Other operations retain the grants of their owning
contracts. Decision authority bounds disposition. These remain distinct
source-owned relations. Observations and arguments
support claims only on their declared subject and basis.

These symbols do not define similarly spelled symbols in method-identity,
traversal, ticket, world-model or calculus contexts.
[Bounded-context resolution](SPEC_METHOD.md#bounded-context-semantic-resolution)
governs cross-context use; no shared default interpretation is inferred.

The premises below are adopted commitments for the selected methodology domain,
not theorems derived from finite capacity alone. Particular method rules need
these premises plus their stated domain and policy choices. A conditional
argument preserves that distinction; it does not manufacture authority.

constraints.statement: Finite attention/context/time/storage/capability is only a resource premise and proves neither purpose, identity, authority nor compatible composition. U_foundation supplies adequacy/value choices; O_subject scoped identity/boundary/current state/material relations; kappa_interpretation available meaning; Sigma_contract obligations/variation; operation authority bounds evaluation effects while other operations retain owner grants; decision authority bounds disposition. These source-owned relations remain distinct; arguments/observations support only declared subjects/bases. Definitions do not alias similarly spelled symbols in other contexts; cross-context resolution is required. Commitments are adopted premises plus domain/policy choices, not consequences of finitude alone, and arguments create no authority.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced bounded-context resolution law is not supplied.

conditions: For selected transformation instances in this domain and their specializations.
exceptions: Only material instance bindings are required; unrelated functions/calculus entities do not acquire purpose fields or mandatory records.

grounding.quote:
For this domain, these premises require a transformation contract to explain
what counts as an adequate result, which subject and interpretation it uses,
what state and material relations survive, which unknown outcomes it admits,
and which effects or dispositions are authorized. Only material bindings are
required by the selected instance. The contract vocabulary is defined once in
[the library's foundational contract](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#foundational-contract).
A function in another domain retains its own dependencies; these commitments do
not add a purpose field or a mandatory record to every calculus entity.

A specialization fixes additional types, predicates, policy and adoption
conditions without discarding its selected generic contract's guarantees. The
[work/recovery argument](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#workrecovery-specialization)
shows the premises, consequences and independent choices for one complete chain.
Each deciding family states the corresponding premises, consequences and
additional choices at its own use contract. A family without that argument
remains an unsupported specialisation.

An argument distinguishes these adopted commitments from the conditions of
its instance. A selected predicate, a persistent workspace, a material join
or a requirement for independent assessment is an instance premise only where
the bound contract supplies it. The argument identifies the deciding owner,
the consumer that applies it and the additional choice left to that owner.
The pillar contributions named in the arguments describe what those premises
contribute; they are neither extra axioms nor permission to infer purpose,
identity or authority from finite capacity. An argument explains its linked
rule and owns no second version of that rule. It requires no extra work record.

constraints.statement: Transformation contracts explain adequacy, subject/interpretation, retained state/material relations, admitted unknown outcomes and authorized effects/dispositions. Specialization adds types/predicates/policy/adoption without discarding selected generic guarantees. Each deciding family states premises, consequences and independent choices at its owning contract; absent that argument it is unsupported. conditions: For activations, dependent reliance, capacity misfit and resumption.
exceptions: An authorized discriminator, first candidate or unrelated work may proceed under its own sufficient grant while another relation is unresolved.
No universal numerical budget, ledger or measurement gate is implied.

grounding.quote:
The [frame laws](REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#reference-frame-laws) own material
sufficiency and capability; the [totality rule](DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md#8-totality-rule)
owns closed design handling. Each activation binds the actor and capability
envelope materially needed by its claim. No universal numeric budget, resource
ledger or measurement gate follows.

selected claim. An authorized useful discriminator, first candidate or unrelated
work can proceed under its own sufficient grant while another relation is

human authority named in RF-014 may select refinement, another actor,

authorized response, requests the owning decision, or stops with an explicit

constraints.statement: Bind the actor and claim-material capability envelope; dependent reliance requires sufficient material context/capability. Report coupled required misfit. RF-014's existing human authority may choose refinement, actor, sequencing or lawful compression, but delegation needs a separate grant. Act on existing authorization, request owning decision, or explicitly stop unresolved; capacity creates no configuration grant and cannot justify substituting easier claims. Bounded construction owns selected-control-domain handling; design totality keeps its preference/applicability without a new algebra. conditions: For consumers relying on or exercising meaning, evaluation, operation or decision authority.
exceptions: One actor may lawfully hold several distinct authorities; already-authorized acts retain grants within current conditions.
Optional Baseline duties apply only where adopted and lawfully activated.

grounding.quote:
This section owns the shared authority-conservation and judgment-separation
determinations. The [imported authority vocabulary](#reference-only-semantic-imports)
keeps its source meanings. A consumer binds the actual owner-issued grant for
its subject, operation or decision, permitted effects and scope. Meaning,
evaluation, operation and decision retain their distinct authority relations,
even when one actor lawfully holds several. A grant is carried only within its
declared scope; delegation or transfer requires the governing owner's
permission.

Actor identity, role or frame selection, a document's presence, available
capability, shared machinery, implementation reachability, evidence shape and
a successful judgment cannot mint, widen, transfer or reconstruct authority.
Missing or ambiguous authority leaves the dependent act ungranted and returns
the applicable explicit result or owner re-entry. An already-authorized act
retains its grant within its current conditions.

Unknown applicability, missing context, incompatible basis and failed predicates
remain observable. Severity grades the supported consequence if a finding manifests. Priority,
disposition, selected action and promotion effect remain distinct; their
assignment follows the applicable mandate. The semantic result remains separate
from the authoritative construction disposition, whose domain conditions belong
to [Spec's proportional disposition](SPEC_METHOD.md#proportional-disposition).

[Construction assurance](#construction-assurance) governs what an assertion,
observation or combination of evidence can establish. The evaluating consumer
binds those relations before relying on a reported pass or failure for a broader
claim. A supported judgment still supplies no operation or decision mandate.

constraints.statement: Bind actual owner-issued subject/operation/decision grants with effects/scope. Meaning, evaluation, operation and decision stay distinct; transfer/delegation requires owner permission. Identity, role/frame selection, documents, tools/capability, shared machinery, reachability, evidence shape and successful judgments cannot create/widen/reconstruct authority. Missing/ambiguous authority leaves dependent acts ungranted with explicit result or owner re-entry. Evidence only supports its claim; Dispose applies bound decision authority. RF-006, AC-014, optional activated Baseline and ODD supply their domain bindings without appointing actors or imposing optional profiles universally. Keep unknown applicability, missing context, incompatible basis and failed predicates visible. Severity concerns supported manifested consequence; priority/disposition/action/promotion remain mandate-bound and distinct from semantics. Bind assurance before using pass/failure for broader claims; supported judgment still grants no act.
constraints.uncertainty: The external domain bindings and proportional-disposition contract are not supplied.

conditions: The governing contract determines whether independence and which authorship/evidence/reference-exposure/actor/configuration conditions are required.
exceptions: Reporting defects, counterexamples or already-required behavior is not by itself repair authorship and allows rechecking.
Unaffected judgments retain scope; shared source/evidence is allowed where governing conditions permit.

grounding.quote:
The governing contract selects whether independent assessment is required and
which authorship, evidence, reference-exposure, actor or configuration conditions
apply to the claim. Where nonauthor assessment is required, its assessor is not
an author of the reviewed subject or repair. Self-review remains authoring
evidence; a human acceptance decision cannot turn it into independent
assessment.

Reporting a defect, supplying a counterexample or identifying behavior already
required by an owning rule does not itself author the repair; that assessor
may recheck the defect. Material wording, policy or design adopted in the
subject is authorship. Its contributor cannot supply the required independent
assessment of that claim; unaffected judgments retain their scope. Any
additional separation or contributor-disclosure duty comes from the applicable
governing contract. Changed subjects, tests or assessment conditions apply
[Change impact and evidence retention](#change-impact-and-evidence-retention)
before the former evidence supports a new claim.

Common source and applicable evidence may be shared where the required
conditions permit. Actor identity, a fresh context or a different model family
alone establishes none of the required independence. [Parallel assurance and
provenance](#parallel-assurance-and-provenance) owns the separate shared-cause
account; [Frame Method](REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#disjointness-and-independence)
owns structural disjointness and procedural evaluation independence. Those
relations do not substitute for claim-relative independent assurance. This
contract selects no extra review boundary, reviewer count or model family.

constraints.statement: Where nonauthor assessment is required, assessors cannot author the reviewed subject/repair. Self-review stays authoring evidence even after human acceptance. Adopted material wording, policy or design is authorship and disqualifies its contributor for that claim's required independent assessment. Additional separation/disclosure comes only from the governing contract. Changed subjects/tests/assessment conditions require change-impact review before evidence reuse. Different actors, fresh contexts and model families alone prove no independence. Shared-cause provenance and Frame Method's structural/procedural independence do not substitute for claim-relative independent assurance. No extra reviewer count, review boundary or model family is selected here.

conditions: For categorical, refinement, cross-account or related mathematical claims.
exceptions: No universal assertion or rejection is made of state sufficiency, statistical Markov properties, conditional independence, Markov categories or runtime monads.

grounding.quote:
Each claimed refinement applies [Preservation obligations](#preservation-obligations)
to its declared meaning and any admitted approximation. Each step uses
laws valid for its declared subject; without additional laws only universally
valid steps are licensed. Laws, records and maps claimed for the method are
represented in a_c with premises, consequences and declared choices distinct.
The calculus, its interpretation and its carriers retain separate identities.
Classify the evidence for each claim as mechanically checked, mathematically
argued, tested against an independently specified oracle or unresolved.
Structural validation supplies no semantic proof. Claiming the method's
categorical construction capability also requires a worked algorithm-to-
computation join; an unproved categorical account remains a hypothesis.

State sufficiency for a selected decision, statistical Markov properties,
conditional independence, a mathematical Markov category and a runtime monad
are separate claims. The method neither asserts nor rejects them universally.
Their domains, laws and falsifiers must be supplied before using them as proof.

constraints.statement: Category claims require domain, objects, typed arrows/equality, identities and associative composition. Functors require object/arrow action plus identity/composition preservation. Conformance to Sigma_contract, functorial preservation, semantic equivalence and computational equivalence are distinct; categorical equivalence additionally requires appropriate quasi-inverse/natural isomorphisms on a stated domain, not analogy or matching outputs. Refinements apply preservation with declared meaning/approximation and subject-valid laws; absent additional laws only universally valid steps are licensed. Method laws/records/maps are represented in a_c with distinct premises/consequences/choices, while calculus, interpretation and carriers keep separate identities. Classify evidence as mechanically checked, mathematically argued, independently-oracled tests or unresolved. Structural validation is not semantic proof; categorical construction capability requires a worked algorithm-to-computation join. Unproved accounts remain hypotheses; separate Markov/state/runtime claims need domains/laws/falsifiers.
constraints.uncertainty: No categorical construction or algorithm-to-computation join is supplied for execution or validation here.

grounding.quote:
for this selected method domain. Particular methods specialize it through their
own types, predicates and authority; it is not six compulsory stages or six
runtime APIs. No operation authority follows from a contract definition.
A changed detailed determination still returns to its owning contract.

constraints.statement: Particular methods specialize the shared vocabulary through their own types, predicates and authority. Definitions do not authorize operations, prescribe six stages or require six runtime APIs. Changed detailed determinations return to the owning contract.
constraints.uncertainty: The six operation contracts themselves are not included.

conditions: For activations and claims of Product acceptance, universal mathematical truth, operational efficiency or release.
exceptions: Independent evaluation may need overlapping context at different capability or evidence altitude.

grounding.quote:
The corpus may exceed one actor's capacity. An activation consumes a sufficient
projected reference frame and exact subject, with acquisition paths for required
material. The projection has declared fidelity and scope; it is not a rival
source of authority. Independent evaluation may require overlapping context at
a different capability or evidence altitude.

Product acceptance, universal mathematical truth, operational efficiency and
release each need their own evidence and authority. Shared law supplies deciding
obligations within its declared scope; a domain binding supplies its particular
predicate and policy. Neither supplies an actor with authority reserved to a
named owner.

constraints.statement: An activation uses sufficient projected frame/exact subject with acquisition paths for required material and declared projection fidelity/scope. Projection does not become authority. Product acceptance, universal truth, efficiency and release each need their own evidence/authority. Shared law supplies scoped deciding obligations and domain bindings supply predicates/policy; neither grants owner-reserved authority.

conditions: For each named predicate's declared evaluation.
exceptions: With not_performed or unconfirmed performance, independently admissible counterevidence or basis/scope diagnosis can support falsified, invalid_basis or out_of_frame without inventing execution; satisfied is forbidden.

grounding.quote:
| `satisfied` | Admissible evidence establishes the predicate under its declared evaluation rule. |
| `falsified` | Admissible evidence establishes a counterexample or failure of that predicate. |
| `indeterminate` | The available admissible evidence does not decide the predicate. |
| `out_of_frame` | The predicate is outside the evaluation's bound scope or capability; it is not silently omitted from the wider obligation. |
| `invalid_basis` | The subject, governing basis or required interpretation is invalid for the claimed evaluation. |

Performance records whether the named predicate's declared evaluation was
actually undertaken; it is `performed`, `not_performed` or `unconfirmed`.
The activation identifies that evaluation separately from dispatch, admission
or the work being assessed. Retain the observed extent, interruption and
conclusion in its outcome and evidence. The legal pairs are:

| Performance | Permitted verdicts | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `performed` | Any of the five verdicts | Evidence establishes that the evaluation was undertaken, including a scoped basis or capability diagnosis. Its extent and conclusion remain separate facts. |
| `not_performed` | Any except `satisfied`, with the evidence condition below | Evidence establishes that the evaluation was not undertaken. Dispatch or admission alone does not establish performance. |
| `unconfirmed` | Any except `satisfied`, with the evidence condition below | Whether the evaluation was undertaken is not established. |

A missing required judgment stays an absent coverage slot, with the known
performance fact or its uncertainty; it is not a fabricated child result. A
performed but undecidable evaluation differs from a known unperformed one and
from unconfirmed execution. A failed admission check can conclude while
downstream work does not. The plan fixes which predicates are required; a
precondition is evidence for its dependent evaluation unless the plan separately
requires that precondition as a predicate. A concluding basis/scope diagnosis
on P reports invalid_basis/out_of_frame on P with its supporting evidence; a
different admission predicate is not silently substituted for P. An aborted
procedure does not erase separately authenticated counterexamples observed
during the attempt. Every result projection preserves these
coordinates and the original predicate; a verdict alone is an insufficient
handoff where performance is material.

constraints.statement: Satisfied requires admissible evidence establishing the bound predicate under its rule; falsified requires counterexample/failure; indeterminate is undecided evidence; out_of_frame diagnoses scope/capability without omitting wider obligation; invalid_basis diagnoses subject/basis/interpretation. Performed allows all five but only establishes undertaking, not completion/satisfaction. Dispatch/admission/work execution are distinct from evaluation performance. Interruption retains performed status, extent and evidence: aborted suites with witnessed failure falsify all-tests-pass; completed inadequate-load tests remain indeterminate on requested performance. Without undertaking/confirmed performance and without independent deciding support, verdict is indeterminate. Missing returns establish neither non-performance nor undecidability: retain absent slots and known facts, never fabricate children. Plan fixes required predicates; preconditions are dependent evidence unless separately required. Report diagnoses on original P rather than substitute admission predicates. Preserve counterexamples, original predicates and all material coordinates in handoffs.

conditions: For every material effect part within its declared observation boundary under the supported operating model and observed departures.
exceptions: An unrequested possible part observed not to begin contributes not_requested with observation and prior uncertainty, whereas a requested part not begun remains not_started.

grounding.quote:
An effect observation is `not_requested`, `not_started`, `completed`, `partial`,
`reverted` or `unknown`, on its declared observation boundary. These values describe the selected effect and observation
boundary, not the predicate verdict. `not_started` needs evidence that the selected effect did not begin, including
an authenticated rejection before mutation. Transport dispatch alone proves
neither effect completion nor absence; `unknown` includes a lost acknowledgment
after possible execution.
`reverted` means that at least one part began and every begun part is observed to have been reversed within
the declared boundary, with the reversal and any unstarted remainder retained
as evidence. For every effect value, the boundary includes each material part
the operation may have affected under its supported operating model and any
observed departure, whether requested or unintended. Irreversible messages or
other material external effects cannot be omitted to improve a result.
`partial` means an observed
completed part and an observed requested but unexecuted, or reverted, remainder.
If any material remainder has unknown completion, the state is `unknown`,
retaining the completed parts as evidence. An effect can be completed while
the intended product outcome is falsified.
An empty local log or discarded context does not establish no effect.
`not_requested` states an established effect-free scope under that operating
model; lack of a request alone is insufficient. A material possible unintended
effect without sufficient observation is `unknown`. If observation establishes
that an unrequested possible part did not begin, it contributes `not_requested`
at this boundary, retaining that observation and any earlier uncertainty.
It is not an uncompleted requested remainder. A requested part observed not to
begin remains `not_started`.

constraints.statement: Effect state is separate from verdict. not_started requires evidence of no beginning, including authenticated pre-mutation rejection. Dispatch alone proves neither completion nor absence; lost acknowledgement after possible execution is unknown. reverted requires at least one begun part and observed reversal of every begun part, retaining reversals/unstarted remainder. partial requires observed completed parts and requested unexecuted/reverted remainder; any unknown material remainder makes the whole unknown while preserving completed evidence. Include all material requested/unintended and external/irreversible parts; none may be omitted to improve results. Completed effects can accompany falsified Product outcomes. Empty logs/context loss prove no absence. not_requested requires established effect-free scope, not merely no request; unobserved possible unintended effects are unknown.

conditions: For domain refinement, decision, candidate, applicability and stopping results.
exceptions: Independent admissible counterevidence or basis/scope diagnosis may decide the same predicate despite an inadmissible missing-reason contribution.

grounding.quote:
A refined value is the pair of original domain outcome and cause in its
declared reason domain, including an explicit missing-reason case. A domain
refinement preserves that qualified original outcome and supplies a
total, reason-sensitive map into this record. If the original outcome is too
coarse to determine a verdict, its required reason distinguishes the cases; a
consumer cannot guess from a word such as `refused`, `ready` or `accepted`.
A missing required reason maps the claimed predicate to indeterminate and
leaves that contribution inadmissible as deciding support for its slot;
retain its raw outcome and unresolved authentication. Its claimed predicate
remains indeterminate until admissible evidence decides it. Independently
established counterevidence or a basis/scope diagnosis uses the legal pairs above
on that same bound predicate; it does not invent execution or completion.
Requested or material possible unintended effects without sufficient observation
are unknown, never defaulted to not_requested. Unconfirmed evaluation performance
stays unconfirmed. Domain meaning stays with its domain owner.
No refinement turns failure, undecidability, non-performance or unknown effect
completion into greater standing. A new result over a different predicate does
not overwrite the earlier result.

Candidate availability, candidate fitness and authorised acceptance are three
predicates. `candidate_ready` can satisfy availability while fitness remains
falsified or unassessed. A lawful yield can satisfy the selected yielding
contract while product completion remains unresolved. A decision result binds
the predicate “disposition D on subject S at basis B was made under mandate M
by its bound authority”. A lawful rejection can satisfy that predicate while
candidate fitness remains undecided. Recording the decision is not its authority.
A not-applicable classification needs a supported applicability judgment; it is
never a synonym for a missing evaluation.

A stop reports the actual destination or task predicate through this record,
with its reason, observed effects and outstanding obligations. Its verdict
is indeterminate when the outcome remains undecided, falsified when admissible
evidence defeats that predicate, or the established scope/basis diagnosis.
Lawfulness of stopping is a separate decision predicate.

constraints.statement: Refinement preserves original qualified outcome plus cause, including missing-reason case, via a total reason-sensitive mapping. Coarse refused/ready/accepted labels cannot choose verdicts. Missing required reason yields indeterminate contribution, inadmissible as deciding support, retaining raw outcome/authentication uncertainty until admissible evidence decides. No invented execution/completion, default effect absence, upgrade of failure/unknown/non-performance, or overwrite by a different predicate is permitted. Availability, fitness and authorized acceptance are separate; candidate_ready may establish only availability. Lawful yield may coexist with unresolved completion. Decision predicate concerns disposition D on S at B under mandate M by bound authority; lawful rejection can satisfy it with undecided fitness, and recorded decisions confer no authority. not_applicable requires supported applicability. Stops report actual task/destination predicate, reason, effects and obligations with indeterminate/falsified/scope/basis result as supported; stop lawfulness is separately judged.

conditions: For an interpretable composite subject/predicate and governing basis.
exceptions: If the composite subject/basis itself is uninterpretable, aggregate invalid_basis retains independently valid component failures.
An unrelated uncertain effect does not automatically invalidate a predicate; relevance requires a dependency.

grounding.quote:
For an interpretable composite predicate and governing basis:

1. Any authenticated, applicable falsification of a required predicate or material join makes
   the conjunction `falsified`. Missing or undecidable other coverage remains
   explicit alongside it.
2. With no such falsification, an invalid required basis prevents satisfaction
   and yields `invalid_basis`; a required out-of-frame judgment yields
   `out_of_frame` when no invalid basis applies.
3. Otherwise any unresolved applicability, missing evaluation, undecidable
   predicate or undecided material join yields `indeterminate`.
4. `satisfied` requires every applicable obligation and material join to be
   authentically satisfied, with coverage itself established. An empty list
   proves nothing unless the declared required set is established as empty.

The composite declaration distinguishes its admission conditions from the
material joins of the predicate being evaluated. Each relation has one of
those roles in that evaluation. A failed admission condition prevents an
interpretation; a false required join is counterevidence within an admitted
interpretation. The result names that declared role instead of reclassifying a
known failed join as a missing basis. If the composite subject or governing basis itself cannot be interpreted, the
aggregate is `invalid_basis`; independently valid component failures and their
scope remain exposed. This does not pronounce them false or forgotten.
Effect uncertainty prevents satisfaction where the predicate requires a known
effect state. An unrelated effect does not automatically invalidate a different
predicate; the dependency relation must justify its relevance.

constraints.statement: Required predicates/joins come from applicability/coverage contracts, not received returns. Authenticate each contribution's producer, subject, basis and plan membership; unauthenticated claims discharge nothing. Missing planned judgments remain absent slots with known/uncertain performance, while obligations outside an authenticated plan remain uncovered; invalid contributions cannot erase authenticated findings. For interpretable composites, precedence is applicable authenticated falsification of any required predicate/join → falsified; otherwise invalid required basis → invalid_basis; otherwise required out-of-frame → out_of_frame; otherwise unresolved applicability/missing evaluation/undecided predicate or join → indeterminate; otherwise satisfied only with authentic satisfaction of all applicable obligations/joins and established coverage. Empty received lists prove nothing unless required set is established empty. Admission conditions and material joins have distinct declared roles: failed admission prevents interpretation; failed joins are counterevidence, not relabeled missing basis. Retain all failures/gaps. Combining-rule application is performed without changing component performance.

conditions: For declared composite effect boundaries and normalized disjoint material part observations.

grounding.quote:
Sequential stages can affect the same part. Their local completion labels are
not inputs to the composite join until mapped onto that part's observed state
at the composite boundary. A completed deployment followed by its completed
rollback is reverted for the deployment effect; a subsequent completed
reapplication is completed there. The historical rollback remains evidence.
The declarations retain every material external part, including irreversible
ones; a local reversal cannot silently remove them from the scope.

Over the resulting disjoint part observations: any unknown gives unknown;
all not_requested gives not_requested; completed with only completed or
not_requested gives completed; not_started with only not_started or
not_requested gives not_started; reverted with only reverted, not_started or
not_requested gives reverted; every remaining fully observed mixture gives
partial. Retain each observation's part and contributing components. The combining
operation's own lack of mutation cannot label an effectful composite not_requested.

constraints.statement: Declare effect boundary/parts, resolve current observations retaining identity, order and supported supersession; later timestamps alone do not supersede. Conflicts/insufficient observations yield unknown. Normalize every materially possibly affected part, even those owned by absent slots, using core effect rules. Map sequential-stage labels to current composite-boundary state: completed deployment then rollback is reverted; reapplication is completed, retaining history and irreversible external effects. conditions: For declared operators, sequential composition and regrouping.
exceptions: Recovery outer predicates need not require failed earlier tests to become true.
Associativity is established only on the stated fixed domain and does not authorize operation reordering.

grounding.quote:
A declared operator states its truth and falsity conditions over exact leaf
predicates and joins. On its fully decided admitted domain, those conditions
are disjoint and exhaustive, including failure of a required join. An
overlapping, incomplete or uninterpretable operator declaration is invalid_basis.
Unresolved well-formedness makes the operator result indeterminate and supplies
neither satisfaction nor falsification; independently valid leaf results remain
visible. Once well-formedness is established, its result can be satisfied only when authenticated
evidence establishes its truth condition and the material joins and coverage
needed for that condition. It can be falsified only on an established falsity
condition. Otherwise a material invalid_basis yields invalid_basis, a material
out_of_frame yields out_of_frame when no invalid basis applies, and every
remaining undecided case is indeterminate. Only dependencies needed to decide
the bound predicate enter that ordering. Authentication, original failure
retention, performance and effect composition remain the rules above. Negation
or disjunction evaluates a different predicate; it cannot erase a failed leaf
or pass that result off as conjunction of all leaves. A first-nonfailure rule
cannot turn an undecided fallback into success.

Sequential composition records an unreturned dependent evaluation as an absent
slot, retaining its observed performance, extent and missing conclusion. A lawful regrouping requires the same interpretable composite basis, required
leaf predicates, joins, normalized effect parts and authentication, with no intermediate basis failure
hidden by the grouping. On that fixed domain, retained component sets combine
by union, the conjunction precedence is associative, and the effect join over
normalized disjoint parts is associative. The argument is mathematical: union
retains the same authenticated leaves under either grouping; selecting the
highest applicable diagnostic in the declared precedence over those leaves
has the same result. Normalized disjoint effect observations likewise retain
наsame parts, so the stated unknown and completion conditions decide the same
aggregate.

constraints.statement: Operators declare exact leaf/join truth/falsity conditions, disjoint and exhaustive on the fully decided admitted domain. Overlap/incompleteness/uninterpretability is invalid_basis; unresolved well-formedness is indeterminate with valid leaves retained. Once well-formed, satisfaction needs authenticated truth-condition evidence plus required joins/coverage; falsification needs established falsity; otherwise relevant invalid_basis precedes out_of_frame, then indeterminate. Only predicate-relevant dependencies enter ordering. Negation/disjunction are different predicates and cannot erase failures or masquerade as all-leaf conjunction; undecided fallback is not success. Unreturned dependent stages remain absent slots with observed extent/performance. Lawful regrouping preserves interpretable basis, leaves, joins, normalized disjoint effects and authentication without hiding intermediate basis failure. On that fixed domain, retained-set union, diagnostic precedence and normalized effect joining are associative; bare verdicts cannot establish equivalence. Arbitrary operators require their own associativity and preserved outer predicate; invalid intermediate joins defeat rewrite premises. Reordering additionally requires effect independence. Sequential operations use their owning contracts (design UP-016/017, a_c AC-016), preservation argument and outer predicate; all-stage-postcondition pipelines conjoin, recovery predicates may differ. Missing interpretation/join returns supported unresolved/invalid-basis outcomes, never guessed success.
constraints.uncertainty: External design and calculus composition contracts are not supplied; the mathematical rules are described, not executed.

conditions: For claimed construction steps, end-to-end preservation, invariants and approximations.
exceptions: Supported local claims remain usable without proving unresolved joins/final implications.

grounding.quote:
Establish the initial condition, each step's applicable premises and the
composition boundaries before using the steps as an end-to-end argument. A
preceding postcondition must establish the next precondition; otherwise acquire
and justify the missing condition. Establish that the final property implies
Z. Supported local claims remain usable when a required join or final implication
is unresolved, but they do not establish that outer claim. For an invariant,
induction requires its initial case and preservation on every admitted step;
neither an invariant nor repeated execution proves progress or termination.

The relation covers every outcome, effect and assumption material to the claim.
A successful-completion relation alone says nothing about refusal, failure,
interruption or unknown effects. Their handling retains the result and recovery
contracts. The actual execution's conformance to the relation is a separate
claim. Concurrency, alternative branches and external effects require their
applicable composition law; a sequential argument supplies none automatically.
The library's [Composition law](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#composition-law) binds
these obligations to the selected operation and its material joins.

Exact transformations preserve the declared meaning. An approximation declares
its adequacy relation and establishes a bound for the whole composition; local
tolerances do not establish that bound by themselves. Across algorithmic,
informational and computational accounts, identify the maps and what they
preserve under [Orthogonal descriptions](#orthogonal-descriptions). A formula
states an obligation; a mathematical argument, structural check, finite model,
sampled test and observed execution retain their distinct subjects and reach.
Execution by a person, machine or mixed arrangement does not by itself discharge
the cross-account maps or preservation obligations.
Unproved universal claims remain unresolved. They stop only work that requires
that proof; otherwise admitted bounded construction can continue.

constraints.statement: For every admitted x,x', require P_i(x) ∧ F_i(x,x') ⇒ P_(i+1)(x'). Establish initial conditions, each step's premises, composition boundaries, predecessor-postcondition/next-precondition implication (or separately justified missing condition), and final-property ⇒ Z before end-to-end reliance. Invariants require initial case and every-step preservation and imply neither progress nor termination. Cover every material outcome/effect/assumption; successful completion alone does not cover refusal/failure/interruption/unknown effects, and actual execution conformance is separate. Concurrency, branching and external effects need applicable laws, not presumed sequential support. Exact transforms preserve declared meaning; approximations require declared adequacy and whole-composition bounds, not just local tolerances. Identify cross-account maps/preservation. Formula, mathematical argument, structural check, finite model, sample and observation have distinct reach; execution alone discharges none of these obligations.

conditions: For interpreting obligations and using assertion results to establish them under Gamma and case domain Omega.
exceptions: Equality can be an oracle for a justified target q_t, including narrower regression properties, while preserving scope and permitted alternatives.

grounding.quote:
An assertion targets q_t. State whether it checks Q_r or a narrower condition,
and support the implication used by the consuming decision:

```text
Q_r implies q_t                     q_t is necessary for Q_r.
q_t implies Q_r                     q_t is sufficient for Q_r.
(q_1 and ... and q_n) implies Q_r    The stated conjunction is sufficient.
```

These are conditional on Gamma and Omega. A pass on a necessary condition
cannot establish Q_r. A collection of assertions needs its own coverage and
compatibility argument before its conjunction establishes Q_r. Valid different
realisations may satisfy Q_r with different outputs. Equality can be an oracle
for a justified declared target q_t, including a narrower regression property;
the conclusion retains that target and scope. Establish its relation to Q_r
before using it to decide the source obligation. Equality alone cannot reject
permitted alternatives or prove full obligation satisfaction.

constraints.statement: Justify Q_r's interpretation with source conditions, exceptions and alternatives; identifiers/digests prove selection, not fidelity. State whether q_t checks Q_r or a narrower property and justify the needed implication: Q_r⇒q_t is necessity; q_t⇒Q_r is sufficiency; conjunction⇒Q_r requires its own coverage/compatibility. Necessary-condition passes cannot prove Q_r. Equality alone neither rejects permitted alternate realizations nor establishes full obligation satisfaction; justify and retain its target/scope before broader use.

conditions: For checker soundness, reported results and claims of always deciding q_t from pi alone.
exceptions: Sound checkers may admit satisfied and indeterminate without always deciding; deterministic checkers are only a functional special case.
Independently admissible additional evidence retains normal standing despite observation limitations.

grounding.quote:
For every s in Omega:
  (pi(s), sat) in T implies q_t(s).
  (pi(s), fal) in T implies not q_t(s).
```

Identify the support and unresolved premises for each claimed direction.
Deterministic checking is a functional special case. Human or probabilistic
checking may admit different conclusions on the same observations; universal
soundness covers every admitted conclusion, not a favourable selected run.
A relation may soundly admit both satisfied and indeterminate without always
deciding. Its shape supplies no probability distribution. A restricted checker
model retains its declared scope; the actual checker and observation acquisition
need their own conformance support. An idealised pi does not prove that an
instrument or actor acquired the material facts correctly.

A checker claiming always to decide q_t correctly from pi alone requires:

```text
For all s and s' in Omega:
  pi(s) = pi(s') implies q_t(s) = q_t(s').
```

If equally observed admissible cases disagree on q_t, acquire distinguishing
evidence, justify a narrower scope, or return indeterminate on that attempted
decision. In a classical set model the condition permits a predicate on the
image of pi; it provides neither an executable decision procedure nor a cost
bound. Additional independently admissible evidence retains its normal core
standing; the limited observation is not permission to erase it.

constraints.statement: For every admitted s, (pi(s),sat)∈T implies q_t(s), and (pi(s),fal)∈T implies ¬q_t(s); identify support/unresolved premises for each direction. scope. Agreement admits shared error as well as correctness; disagreement
requires diagnosis and does not identify the faulty party by itself. Account for
material shared specifications, interpretations, tools, fixtures, observations,
copied contributions and other failure causes. Different actors, families or
codebases do not establish statistical independence. Repeating an observation
does not make it new independent evidence; required authorship independence
applies [Independent assessment](#independent-assessment).

the desired outcome. Validation uses the model's declared purpose and material

Agreement may be shared error; disagreement requires diagnosis without selecting a culprit. Account for shared specifications, interpretations, tools, fixtures, observations, copied contributions and other material causes. Different actors/models/codebases and repeated observations prove no statistical independence; authorship independence remains separately governed. conditions: For assurance selection; quantitative formulas require defined supporting models and conditioning events.
exceptions: Unsupported numerical confidence remains unresolved, while qualitative evidence may remain usable under policy/limits.
No universal probability threshold or per-test probability estimate is required.

grounding.quote:
P(V | E, Gamma) =
  P(E | V, Gamma) P(V | Gamma)
  / [P(E | V, Gamma) P(V | Gamma)
     + P(E | not V, Gamma) P(not V | Gamma)].
```

The denominator must be nonzero and every used conditional defined. Agreement,
disagreement or another observation may be E; its likelihood in faulty and
non-faulty conditions matters. The equation supplies no missing prior or
likelihood. Its numerical conclusion is bounded by the supporting model and
evidence; agreement can fail to increase confidence when shared causes or new
information change that model.

P(M_1 and ... and M_n | V, Gamma)
  = product over i of P(M_i | V, Gamma, M_1, ..., M_(i-1)).
```

Use the factorisation only on defined conditioning events; handle a
zero-probability prefix without inventing a conditional value. Replacing a
conditional factor with P(M_i | V, Gamma) requires the relevant conditional
independence under that model. One minus the joint miss probability is the
chance of at least one detection under those conditions, not the probability
that the whole product is correct.

Sampled cases or injected defects calibrate only their justified relation to
operational failures. Unsupported numerical confidence remains unresolved;
qualitative evidence remains usable within governing policy and stated limits.
No universal probability threshold or per-test probability estimate is required.
The assurance and risk policy constrain cost selection rather than disappearing
when a cheaper plan is available.

constraints.statement: Admitted work authority selects assurance for obligations, consequences and resource limits, binding coverage/uncertainty/action/acceptance conditions. Bayes: P(V|E,Gamma)=P(E|V,Gamma)P(V|Gamma)/[P(E|V,Gamma)P(V|Gamma)+P(E|not V,Gamma)P(not V|Gamma)], with nonzero denominator and defined conditionals; equations supply no missing parameters, and agreement need not raise confidence under changed models/shared causes. Joint miss probability is the product over i of P(M_i|V,Gamma,M_1,...,M_(i-1)); undefined/zero-prefix conditioning cannot be invented. Marginal replacement requires relevant conditional independence. Risk/assurance policy continues to constrain cheaper plans.
